news.headline: Fauji Cement (FCCL) posts highest-ever FY26 profit after strong Q4 earnings
news.summary: Follow-up to the 2026-08-11 newslog entry that logged the FCCL FY2026 filing date only, with figures unconfirmed due to a DPS label mismatch. ProPakistani (published 2026-08-11) reports Fauji Cement Company Limited (PSX: FCCL) posted its highest-ever full-year profit after tax of Rs16.2bn in FY2026 (year ended June 30, 2026), a 10-year profit CAGR of 22%. 4QFY26 alone: profit after tax Rs5.40bn, EPS Rs2.20, up 38% YoY and 56% QoQ; net revenue up 10% YoY and 7% QoQ to Rs23.90bn in 4QFY26, driven by domestic dispatches up 15% YoY to 1.35m tonnes. Board declared a final cash dividend of Rs1.50/share for 4QFY26. Logged as impact 4 (material earnings result - highest-ever annual profit) per desk news-impact criteria (Rule 10); escalation flagged.

news.headline: Attock Cement (ACPL) posts strong FY26 earnings despite 4Q margin pressure
news.summary: Follow-up to the 2026-08-11 newslog entry that logged the ACPL FY2026 filing date only, with figures unconfirmed due to a DPS label mismatch and conflicting same-day price-move reports. Cemnet.com ('Attock Cement posts strong FY26 earnings despite 4Q margin pressure') reports 4QFY26 (quarter ended June 30, 2026): net revenue up 16% YoY to Rs11.2bn; operating profit fell 27% YoY to Rs1.2bn on weaker gross profitability and higher distribution costs; PAT surged 127% YoY to Rs956m, aided by finance costs down 43% YoY to Rs275m, other income up 42% YoY to Rs266m, and taxation down 81% YoY to Rs163m (effective tax rate 14.5% vs 66.9% a year earlier). No full-year FY2026 PAT/EPS or dividend figure was confirmed in the source reviewed this cycle. Logged as impact 3 (notable, mixed quarterly results - PAT surge driven substantially by below-the-line items rather than core margin improvement) pending full-year figures in a follow-up cycle.

news.headline: Auto sector urged to lead Pakistan's $63bn export ambitions
news.summary: Published Aug 13, 2026 11:13am PKT: Federal Minister for Planning Ahsan Iqbal, Federal Minister for Energy Sardar Awais Ahmad Khan Leghari, and SAPM on Industries Haroon Akhtar Khan called on the auto sector to shift toward export-led growth to help meet Pakistan's $63bn export target (part of a broader $100bn national export goal) under the URAAN Pakistan initiative; called for Auto Policy 2.0 implementation, five-year export plans and industrial-cluster modernisation. No new concrete measures, subsidies, or company-level figures announced - a policy exhortation/speech, not a binding action. Logged as impact 2 (minor, sector-wide policy commentary) tagged to auto-sector constituents.

news.headline: Oil climbs on fresh vessel attacks, Oman spill
news.summary: Published Aug 13, 2026 10:15am PKT per Mettis Global: Brent crude (Oct delivery) rose 1.01% to $88.09/bbl and WTI (Sept delivery) rose 1.15% to $82.31/bbl on Thursday, per CNBC coverage, following fatal attacks on vessels in the Red Sea/Bab el-Mandeb Strait and the Gulf of Oman, plus a spreading oil spill (approx. 400 sq km) off Oman's coast from a sanctioned tanker that ran aground June 30 carrying an estimated 800,000 barrels of Russian crude. Sub-2% single-session commodity move, continuation of the ongoing Hormuz/Gulf-tension narrative already logged repeatedly this newslog; logged as impact 3 (notable, oil-price-relevant geopolitical development) tagged to E&P and OMC/refiner constituents.
